ko: 내가 이 자리에 선 것도 주의 부르심이라
en: For the calling of God is irrevocable, There’s no taking back or change I believe it’s the Lord who called me here, For His own purpose and grace
There’s no error or a mistake I believe in God who’s faithful He’s the one Who has called me

ko: 작은 나를 부르신 뜻을 나는 알 수 없지만
오직 감사와 순종으로 주의 길을 가리라
en: I don’t know why He has called me, but He’s my God and Lord with a grateful heart I must follow Him To the end in this narrow path

ko: 때론 내가 연약해져도 주님 날 도우시니
주의 놀라운 그 계획을 나는 믿으며 살리
en: When the trials come my way again He’s my help and I don’t fear God’s will and purpose surely will be completed when I believe

ko: 날 부르신 뜻 내 생각보다 크고
날 향한 계획 나의 지혜로 측량 못하나
en: God’s purpose in my life is much greater than my thoughts The plans God has for me is amazing beyond any measure

ko: 가장 좋은 길로 가장 완전한 길로
en: I believe my God, my heavenly Father will Lead me on today to His perfect way
